newsitem.title: CHINA: China retail sales up 19.4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China retail sales up 19.4 pct in 1996.

text.p: China's retail sales of consumer goods rose by 19.4 in 1996 compared with the previous year to hit 2,461.43 billion yuan, the State Statistical Bureau said in figures issued on Friday.
China's top three consuming regions were the provinces of Guangdong, Jiangsu and Shandong, it said.
Last year, retail sales in southern Guangdong stood at 259.48 billion yuan, up 16.9 percent compared with the previous year.

Retail sales in eastern Jiangsu mounted to 199.38 billion yuan, an increase of 20.8 percent from 1995 while sales in neighbouring Shandong were 171.56 billion yuan, up 21.2 percent from the previous year.
